fixture.kickoff_timezone_provenance: PremierLeague.com official fixture identity previously captured in R39R/R39S; UTC conversion from 20:00 BST

market_source.independence_rule: Treat Infobetting as one provider group. Listed bookmakers are not counted as independent markets in R44A.

purpose: Bootstrap an auditable V5.2 forward-PIT evidence path using an official Premier League lineup page plus one public odds-aggregator provider group. R44A records collector first-observed timestamps and payload hashes, then separately proves synchronized H/D/A, Asian and multi-line OU source coverage. It does not create a formal market snapshot or predictive claim.

stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_SOURCE_FEASIBILITY_NOT_FORMAL_: Official lineup state is captured pre-kickoff and an exact Infobetting fixture page is captured for the same fixture. This remains only a broad source-feasibility receipt.
stage1_success_semantics.PASS_R44A_SYNCHRONIZED_MARKET_SOURCE_COV: In one collector run, dedicated H/D/A, Asian and Under/Over pages for the same provider group all expose Arsenal-Coventry, pass role-specific coverage checks, are observed before kickoff, and stay within the frozen synchronization span.
stage1_success_semantics.STOP_R44A_MARKET_DISCOVERY_NO_MATCH: Official lineup evidence may be valid, but no qualifying market page was discovered inside the frozen request budget. Stop before any label/model work.
